Good afternoon Dusan,

Thanks for checking in. Your order Shop····, the BSB B30 with the Power Kit, is paid and ships on November 7, going to Chicago. Nothing has left the warehouse yet, and you will get the tracking number by email the moment the label is printed.

The unit is being built for you in that batch rather than sitting on a shelf, which is why the date is firm rather than immediate. You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

If anything moves on our side, I will let you know in this thread.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
